# Questions for the lawyer

**From:** the Managing Director, NexaCrest International Private Limited. **Prepared:** 6 Nov 2026.

NexaCrest exports natural stone and will soon sell other goods (for example engineering products). Our order system issues the quotation, proforma invoice, order confirmation, commercial invoice and supplier purchase order, each with our terms and conditions, and it pays commission to independent associates who bring us buyers. The system already follows the rules below. The agreements and the printed terms must say the same thing, so please review and draft as asked. The detailed change notes are in `docs/legal/D-245-lawyer-notes.md`; this pack lists what we need back from you.

For each question: **Today** is what the system does now; **Where** is what we change after your answer.

## B. Terms and conditions for goods other than natural stone (needed before the first non-stone sale)

**5. Please review these clauses.** They print on the quotation, proforma invoice, order confirmation and commercial invoice for non-stone orders (clauses 5a–5d), and on the supplier purchase order (5e–5f). We wrote them ourselves; they have not been reviewed. Natural stone clauses are unchanged. `{tolerance}` is filled in by the system with the order's tolerance %.

**5a. Product Characteristics**
> Product Characteristics: Goods are supplied to the specification agreed in this document. Minor variation within the manufacturer's stated tolerances is not a defect. Products will conform to the agreed specification.

**5b. Specification & Drawings**
> Specification & Drawings: Goods are made to the buyer-approved drawing and the specification in this document. Dimensions and tolerances are as per the approved drawing. Any change after approval needs the written agreement of both parties and may change the price and the delivery date.

**5c. Quantity Tolerance (Goods)**
> Quantity Tolerance: Actual quantity shipped will not exceed the ordered quantity. A shortfall of up to {tolerance}% may occur due to production yield and will be invoiced at actual quantity shipped. Buyer will be notified in writing before shipment of any shortfall exceeding {tolerance}%, and shipment will require buyer's written approval.

**5d. Quality Documents**
> Quality Documents: The quality documents listed in this document (for example a Mill Test Certificate EN 10204 3.1) are supplied with the shipment, and each item can be traced to them by its heat or serial number.

**5e. Conformity to Specification** (supplier purchase order)
> All items must conform exactly to the specification and drawing given in Section 3. No substitution of material or grade without NexaCrest's written approval.

**5f. Traceability & Test Certificates** (supplier purchase order)
> Each item must be traceable by its heat or serial number to the quality documents supplied with it (for example a Mill Test Certificate EN 10204 3.1). Goods without the required documents will not be accepted.

- Where: Admin › Overrides (the wording can be changed without a code change).
